say:1:1060603001:1.text: Wow! Not only did you put everything back in, but so neatly too! It's like magic!
say:1:1060603001:1.source_cn: 哇……不但全都装回去了，还井井有条的！简直就是魔法！
say:1:1060603001:1.male: Wow! Not only did you put everything back in, but so neatly too! It's like magic!
say:1:1060603001:1.female: Wow! Not only did you put everything back in, but so neatly too! It's like magic!

say:2:1060603002:1.text: I can't give you these old, worn items... I would rather give you something else as compensation.
say:2:1060603002:1.source_cn: 这些破破烂烂的货物，我也不好意思送给你……还是给你其他...
say:2:1060603002:1.male: I can't give you these old, worn items... I would rather give you something else as compensation.
say:2:1060603002:1.female: I can't give you these old, worn items... I would rather give you something else as compensation.

say:3:1060603003:1.text: By the way, thanks for the advice. I'll keep it in mind when I go out to acquire new items for sale. I hope I can join the Mithril Consortium soon.
say:3:1060603003:1.source_cn: 对了，也谢谢你给我的建议，我都牢牢记住了，一定会想办法...
say:3:1060603003:1.male: By the way, thanks for the advice. I'll keep it in mind when I go out to acquire new items for sale. I hope I can join the Mithril Consortium soon.
say:3:1060603003:1.female: By the way, thanks for the advice. I'll keep it in mind when I go out to acquire new items for sale. I hope I can join the Mithril Consortium soon.

say:4:1060603004:1.text: When the time comes, I will prepare another gift to thank you!
say:4:1060603004:1.source_cn: 到时候，我再准备一份礼物来谢你！
say:4:1060603004:1.male: When the time comes, I will prepare another gift to thank you!
say:4:1060603004:1.female: When the time comes, I will prepare another gift to thank you!
